players.product: CMP diamond pad conditioners and reclaimed wafers

quarterly_data.signal: Kinik Q2 2026 investor deck: 2Q26 consolidated revenue NT$2,492,667 thousand (NTD 2.49B), up 8.7% QoQ and 17.9% YoY; gross margin 40.1%, up 5.1 ppt QoQ; operating margin 24.2%; net income to shareholders of the parent NT$523,376 thousand; EPS NTD 3.49. 1H26 revenue NTD 4.79B, up 23.1% YoY; gross margin 37.6%; EPS NTD 6.44. The company says revenue and gross margin growth were mainly driven by QoQ growth across all three business units.
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q26 revenue NTD 2.49B (+8.7% QoQ, +17.9% YoY); gross margin 40.1%; EPS NTD 3.49; 1H26 revenue NTD 4.79B (+23.1% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: 2Q26 by business unit: DBU (CMP diamond disk) revenue NT$782,669 thousand (31%, +9.1% QoQ, +26.1% YoY), supported by higher CMP diamond disk shipments for 2nm/1.6nm processes customer; SBU (test/reclaim wafer) NT$1,077,658 thousand (43%, +4.4% QoQ, +14.4% YoY), driven by full utilization of 360K/month 12-inch capacity and increased shipments of specialty wafers. For its largest single (unnamed) customer, advanced node products including sub-5nm and advanced packaging accounted for 61.2% of total revenue; 2nm diamond disk sales surged 84%.
quarterly_data.figure: DBU NT$782,669 thousand (+9.1% QoQ, +26.1% YoY); SBU NT$1,077,658 thousand (+4.4% QoQ); 2nm diamond disk sales +84%

quarterly_data.signal: Kinik commenced shipments of CMP diamond disks for 1.4nm in 2Q26 (Q2 2026 deck, data for its largest single customer).

Kinik capacity and capex (Q2 2026 deck): 2026 CapEx budget NT$1.5 billion, to expand DBU diamond disk monthly capacity to 70k units and SBU 12-inch wafer monthly capacity to 400k pieces. Diamond disk capacity reached 60k units/month in Q2 2026, targeting 70k+ units/month by Q4 2026; 12-inch capacity expanded to 400k pieces/month since June and is expected to remain fully loaded through year-end, with added capacity primarily dedicated to high-end reclaimed wafers for advanced node customers; 2027 outlook: capacity will further expand to 430k pieces/month.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 CapEx budget NT$1.5 billion; diamond disk 60k units/month (Q2 2026) -> 70k+ (Q4 2026); 12-inch 400k pieces/month since June -> 430k (2027)

quarterly_data.signal: Kinik 2026 outlook (Q2 2026 deck): demand for advanced node and advanced packaging diamond disks is expected to surge sequentially (QoQ); the company is expanding market share and steadily ramping up shipment volumes to US memory and IDM customers.
